newsitem.title: FINLAND: LIPPONEN "IN GOOD HEALTH" - GOVT CHIEF SPOKESMAN.
newsitem.headline: LIPPONEN "IN GOOD HEALTH" - GOVT CHIEF SPOKESMAN.

text.p: Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen was in good health on Tuesday afternoon after being treated at a Copenhagen hospital for a heart rhythm problem, a senior government official travelling with the prime minister said.
"He is in good health," government chief spokesman Asko Mattila told Reuters by telephone from Copenhagen.
During the night to Tuesday, Lipponen had noticed that something was wrong and decided to seek treatment straight away, Mattila said.

The diagnosis by doctors at the Copenhagen central hospital was that the prime minister had suffered from a heart rhythm disturbance, Mattila said, adding he did not have any information about the severity of the problem.
"I visited him at the hospital. He did not seem to be in any trouble," Mattila said. "He was waiting to leave for the airport to catch the flight home."
Lipponen is due to arrive in Helsinki at 1835 local time (1635 GMT) on a regular scheduled flight.
